gbp-setup.check: The name matches the sign, website and receipts exactly: no city or keywords added
gbp-setup.why: Google's guidelines; extra words can get a profile suspended

gbp-setup.check: Main category is the most specific true one (e.g. 'Emergency plumber' only if they offer it)
gbp-setup.why: The main category matters most for which searches show you

gbp-setup.check: Up to 9 extra categories, each one true for the business
gbp-setup.why: Each one can show you for more searches

gbp-setup.check: A real place where they meet customers, or a hidden address with a service area
gbp-setup.why: Virtual offices and mail boxes are not allowed

gbp-setup.check: Towns or zip codes they really serve (not a whole state)
Opening hours correct, plus holiday hours for the next 2 holidays
gbp-setup.why: Wrong hours are the top customer complaint

gbp-setup.check: A local number that is answered; the same number as the website
Links to the right page of the website (https)
gbp-setup.why: Sends searchers to the right place

gbp-setup.check: 750 characters or less, plain words: what they do, where, why choose them; no links or offers
gbp-setup.why: The first thing many people read

gbp-setup.check: Each main service listed with a short description (and a price if they share it)
The true attributes set (e.g. wheelchair access, women-owned, online appointments)
Logo, cover, outside (so people find the door), inside, team, 5+ work photos; all owned by the business
gbp-setup.why: Profiles with real photos get more clicks and calls

gbp-setup.check: Review link copied and shared; every review from the last 90 days has a reply
gbp-setup.why: Replies show you care; the link makes asking easy

gbp-setup.check: A post in the last 7 days (offer, update or tip) with a photo and a button
Booking or quote link set if they take online bookings
gbp-setup.why: One tap from search to booked

gbp-setup.check: Search Maps for the name: no duplicate or old listing
gbp-setup.why: Duplicates split reviews and confuse Google

gbp-setup.check: Name, address and phone are the same on Facebook, Yelp, Apple Maps, Bing Places
The owner is the Owner; helpers (us) are Managers, removed when done
